name: file-format-icon
title: File Format Icon
description: A file icon with a colored format badge, useful for representing file types.

docs.lead: A file document icon with a colored format badge in the bottom-left corner, useful for visually representing different file types.
docs.usage:
import * as FileFormatIcon from "@/components/ui/file-format-icon"

<FileFormatIcon.Root format="PDF" color="red" />

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A file icon with a red PDF format badge.

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: All available semantic colors for different file types.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Available in medium (40px) and small (32px) sizes.

api.name: FileFormatIcon.Root
api.description: The file format icon SVG element.

props.name: format
props.description: The file format text to display in the badge (e.g., 'PDF', 'DOC').

props.name: color
props.description: The semantic color of the format badge.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the icon (medium: 40px, small: 32px).
